title: Tenant retention schedule with floor checks and automated disposition
objective: Retention schedules are tenant configuration by record class; configuration below a documented legal floor is rejected; a disposition job evaluates expiry and holds daily and records each disposition or deferral.
owner: Records and retention owner (proposed role; not appointed)
residual_risks: Legal floors are only as accurate as counsel's input.

title: Hold-aware disposition and erasure
objective: Disposition and erasure services must query active holds before acting; a hold record blocks the action and generates a conflict notice; hold records are append-only.
implementing_systems: Unbound retention and erasure services (not built)
owner: Records and retention owner (proposed role; not appointed)

title: Key-scoped storage with logged key destruction
objective: Customer data at rest is encrypted under per-tenant keys (and per-person keys for identity vault data) in a managed key service with destruction logging; deletion of a scope is executed as key destruction plus ciphertext removal where feasible.
residual_risks: Provider-side key backup and retention periods for deleted keys are governed by the provider.

title: Post-restore erasure replay
objective: A restore cannot be promoted to serving until erasure, disposition and hold events recorded after the backup point have been replayed against it; the annual restore test verifies this.
residual_risks: If the erasure event log itself is lost, replay is incomplete.

title: Hash-over-ciphertext event chain
objective: Event integrity hashes are computed over stored bytes in which personal fields are ciphertext under erasable keys, so key destruction leaves chain verification intact; projections are rebuilt after erasure.
implementing_systems: Unbound event store (not built; PostgreSQL per CNV-ARC-001)
residual_risks: Scope is structured personal fields; free text and attachments outside the scheme are not covered.
notes: L1 applies only to structured event fields routed through the encryption scheme.

title: Regulated-record designation
objective: Record classes that a customer designates as required regulatory records are stored append-only with time-stamped audit trail, indexed for retrieval, and covered by a production drill; designation is per tenant contract.
owner: Records and retention owner (proposed role; not appointed)

title: Evidence-generated deletion certificate
objective: Deletion certificates are produced only by a generator that assembles key destruction, disposition, backup expiry and subprocessor confirmation evidence; a certificate cannot be issued while any scope lacks evidence.
owner: Records and retention owner (proposed role; not appointed)
